thread:
tasha: Quick heads-up — we're cutting the release tomorrow morning. Please double-check your changelog entries: short, actionable, and include the PR link + a one-line user-facing summary. If you added anything vague ("misc fixes") please update it before EOD.

kevin: Are we enforcing the entry "type" tags now? e.g. "fix", "feat", "ops"? Will CI fail if missing?

devops-bot: changelog-lint v2.1 enabled in CI — missing type or PR link will cause the release job to FAIL. Run `tools/changelog-lint --verify` locally to pre-check.

emily: Example of a good entry:
```text
runtime: fix — reduce kv-cache memory leak on long-lived streams (PR #4521) — user impact: reduced OOMs
```
Also add the `#changelog` label to the PR for discovery.

jess: Who's doing the version bump on main vs release branches this time? We hit double-bumps last cycle.

tasha: I'll own the main bump after the branch cut. For release/X.Y.z branches the release lead (see the Release doc) should bump during the cut. Important: do NOT bump main before the branch merge — that creates merge conflicts and duplicate bump PRs.

kevin: If someone accidentally bumps main early, what recovery flow do you want us to follow?

release-bot: Recovery steps (automated checklist):
1) Revert the premature version bump PR on main.
2) Cherry-pick the intended release commits into the release branch.
3) Run `tools/changelog-lint --fix` and re-open the changelog PR.
Ping the release lead (`@tasha` or the on-call) for manual help if CI still fails.

tasha: Micro-guidelines to avoid friction:
- Keep entries to one concise sentence + parenthetical PR link.
- Use explicit prefixes: `runtime:`, `api:`, `docs:`, `ops:`.
- If your change is customer-visible add a short "user impact" phrase.
- Avoid "misc" / "internal" as the only descriptor — add context.

jess: I'll scan open PRs and nudge owners this afternoon. If you want me to edit an entry for wording, @me and I'll help.

kevin: Thanks — running the linter now and will push fixes if needed. :thumbsup:
